title: Sequenced release matrix & cross-team war room for APAC dedicated SKU launch
creator: Asha Raman
description: Coordinated go-to-market for Dedicated capacity launch in APAC (Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul) covering new instance SKUs, reservation plans, and staging of gradual customer opt-in. Primary outcome: a sequenced release matrix with committed milestone owners, an operational war room during launch weeks, and synchronized release notes + partner enablement artifacts. This ticket covers cross-functional planning, final approval gating, and the rollout communication cadence (internal + external).
acceptance_criteria: Sequenced release matrix completed and reviewed by Eng, Console, Docs, and Sales
Release notes drafted, reviewed, and scheduled in the product release calendar
Console supports new SKUs in the reservation flow and quota UI validated in beta region
Engineering runbook and on-call escalation matrix published to Confluence
Sales and Solutions enablement pack (pricing matrix, FAQ, migration guide) delivered to partners
All blocking dependencies resolved or have mitigation plans (listed in dependencies)
tasks: Create sequenced-release matrix (region x SKU x commit plan) - owner: Product
Finalize SKU definitions & performance profiles with Serving Runtime team - owner: Eng (ENG-18221)
Reservation plan copy + pricing spreadsheet - owner: Finance/Sales
Console changes: reservation UI + SKU selector - owner: Console Eng (ENG-20456)
Docs: Release notes draft, migration guide, and API examples - owner: Docs
Partner enablement: create slide deck + playbook for channel partners - owner: GTM
Legal: sign-off on regional T&Cs and data residency wording
Run simulated capacity tests in staging and capture latency/cost metrics
Schedule and staff launch war room for 2025-03-10 through 2025-03-14
communication_plan: Internal announcement: 2025-02-28 email to all teams with milestones and on-call rota
Customer announcement: staged emails for beta customers (2025-03-05) and GA customers (2025-03-15)
Release notes: publish on product status page and docs site the morning of GA
Partner briefing: live webinar for top 20 partners on 2025-03-06
Support playbook: CS/Support training session on 2025-03-07
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Console SKU selector regression impacts reservation flow - Mitigation: feature flag + canary in Singapore region
Risk: Kernel scheduling causes increased p99 latency on H100 SKU - Mitigation: hold GA until ENG-19990 profiling work completes and enable fallback instance variant
Risk: Pricing miscommunication to partners - Mitigation: lock price spreadsheet and require GTM sign-off before publish
Risk: Legal/regulatory delay in Tokyo - Mitigation: push Tokyo GA by one week and roll Singapore first
